purpose: Add 阿厚綾’s verified physical photobook edition, its official retailer cover and a current bookstore asking-price observation; keep digital format separate unless a digital edition is verified.

works.title: 《綾の邊界 きわ》阿厚綾
works.composition: 阿厚綾（Aya）首本個人實體寫真書，以溫泉、和服、居家、中式氛圍與泳裝等場景呈現甜美到性感的多面形象。

editions.label: 標準版
editions.metadataNote: Kingstone says paperback, 16開19×26cm. ISBN blank and page count zero on page; not inferred.

activeOffers.evidence: Kingstone product page showed NT$890 (list price NT$980), an enabled checkout/add-to-cart action, and limited inventory on 2026-10-07. This is a bookstore asking price, not a secondary-market or sold price.

editions.digitalEdition: No separate digital retailer product was found in public searches of exact title across Kingstone, BOOK☆WALKER, Readmoo, Rakuten/Kobo and Pubu; treat this as not found, not proof that none exists.

notes: Kingstone product page identifies this as a physical paperback and shows an enabled order action at NT$890 on 2026-10-07. This is retail price only; no completed-sale price or used-marketplace listing is asserted.
Books.com was promoted by the model’s agency in August, but the current product endpoint returned HTTP 403, so no current offer or price was imported.
Image downloaded from Kingstone product page; R2 PUT, HEAD and public GET all returned HTTP 200 and public SHA-256 exactly matched the downloaded image.

Exact-title searches for Ruten, Yahoo Auctions and other public marketplace results did not surface a separately verifiable active or completed listing. This is a search result limitation, not proof that no secondary-market listing exists; no marketplace or sold-price observation was imported.
